title: The Pinata Gauntlet! IV
description: The Pinata Gauntlet! IV — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_B

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Destroy 3 Pinatas and 12 Pinata Turrets in the Pinata Gauntlet off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: QuestGiver_B

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Destroy 3 Pinatas and 12 Pinata Turrets in the Pinata Gauntlet off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

Well, one thing is for sure, you don't have to prove yourself anymore. That doesn't mean you can't rub in how great you are, though! I say you should go into the Pinata Gauntlet and let everyone see what a great Pinateer you are! Then maybe they will write songs about your exploits in the Pinata Invitational and how you only cried that one time you got poked in the eye. You will be remembered forever!

When you are ready you should head down to the entrance to the Pinata Invitational off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag to begin. This time you will need to destroy the Pinata three times and the Pinata Turrets twelve times. It may sound hard, and it is, so don't get all teary eyed on me. Good luck and when you are done return to me, the Excited Lad, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when you are done.

Turn-in:

Alas, you have returned victorious! As of right now no bards have written a song about you, but the Townston Chronicle's advice columnist wrote a great haiku about you. If I could read, or knew what a haiku was, I would tell you about it.

Objectives:

  • Destroy Pinatas
  • Destroy Pinata Turrets

Client level range: 90–100
